Beautifully upgraded and renovated, this home combines luxury, comfort, and outdoor living in the heart of the city. The expansive terrace creates the perfect space for entertaining guests, outdoor dining, or simply relaxing while enjoying breathtaking views of Downtown Dubai's skyline.

Positioned directly on the Boulevard, residents enjoy immediate access to Dubai Mall, world-class restaurants, cafes, luxury retail, and the vibrant lifestyle that Downtown Dubai is famous for.
